correctness.red: The model-scale wrapper test initially failed because the cooperative GQA primitive did not exist.
correctness.green: The production-shaped M128 preappend fixture matched retained qrow6 for every F32 output bit for both K64 and K32 bodies.

k64.geometry: local192; six wave32s; qrow6 per query head; one K64 K/V tile shared across six query heads
k64.trace_command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 rocprofv3 --kernel-trace --output-directory /tmp/laguna-lc1-gqa6-k64-trace.8HD38c --output-format csv --output-file lc1gqa6 -- env PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_laguna_kv_attention.py -k preappend_cached_qrow4

k32.trace_command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 rocprofv3 --kernel-trace --output-directory /tmp/laguna-lc1-gqa6-k32-trace.q0fkpO --output-format csv --output-file lc1gqa6k32 -- env PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_laguna_kv_attention.py -k preappend_cached_qrow4

decision.reason: K32 recovers occupancy and is substantially better than K64, but both remain slower at every context. LC-0 request amplification is therefore predominantly cache-served; LDS staging does not accelerate the serial QK, exp, and PV arithmetic and adds synchronization/resource cost.
decision.next_premise: Close scalar staging. Establish a bounded M128-by-context F32 hipBLASLt ceiling, then implement block-streamed tensorized QK/PV with GQA reuse and online tile reductions.
